responsibility: Implements `#[rustc_on_unimplemented]` handling for trait errors, selecting the most relevant trait or impl annotation, validating and formatting its conditional message templates, and producing customized notes from obligation context and instantiated trait arguments.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `traits/on_unimplemented.rs`, which defines the generic attribute AST, parsing, validation, and string-substitution engine for `#[rustc_on_unimplemented]`, this file is the diagnostic-side integration point: it inspects a failing obligation, chooses the relevant trait or matching impl annotation, derives context flags such as enclosing item, desugaring, and method/cause information, and then asks the shared directive machinery to produce the final note.
